points_of_interest.name: Perseverance landing site
points_of_interest.description: Octavia E. Butler Landing: the Mars 2020 rover touched down here, in Jezero crater, on 18 February 2021.

points_of_interest.name: Syrtis Major
points_of_interest.description: Dark shield volcano west of Isidis Planitia, the first surface feature of Mars ever drawn from Earth (Huygens, 1659).

points_of_interest.name: Isidis Planitia
points_of_interest.description: Plain inside a giant impact basin about 1500 km across.

points_of_interest.name: Beagle 2 lander
points_of_interest.description: British lander that reached the surface on 25 December 2003 but never called home. Found in 2015 on orbital images, its solar panels only partly open.

points_of_interest.name: Nili Fossae
points_of_interest.description: Group of large troughs north-east of Syrtis Major, rich in clays and carbonates.
